warning: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. This is a repo-local Ed25519 development keypair generated for LEDGER-010's signed checkpoint test evidence. It is checked in deliberately (an Ed25519 private key has no secret-derivation step to strip) so that this package's tests can sign and verify a fixture manifest deterministically without a real signing ceremony. THIS KEY MUST NEVER BE USED TO SIGN A PRODUCTION CHECKPOINT, AN INTEGRITY EPOCH, OR ANYTHING BESIDES THE FIXTURES UNDER THIS PACKAGE. It carries no operational authority: internal/data/ledger/checkpoint.Signer is a port precisely so that a real deployment supplies its key from a KMS or HSM and this file is never reachable from one.
shape_note: Same field shape as tools/planning/gateevidence/testdata/dev-signing-key.yaml, rendered as JSON rather than YAML: gopkg.in/yaml.v3's allowed_import_roots in definitions/architecture/dependency-roles.yaml do not include internal/data, and a test fixture is not a reason to widen a library firewall.
